title: GP surgery confirming an appointment (not a scam)

scammer_turns.text: Hello, it's Priya calling from Meadowbank Surgery. I'm just ringing about your appointment next week.
We've got you down to see Dr Okafor on Tuesday at twenty past ten in the morning. Does that still suit you?
Lovely. It's the usual review for your blood pressure, nothing to worry about at all.
If you could bring your repeat prescription list with you, that would help the doctor, but don't worry if you can't find it.
The car park is being resurfaced this week, so you might want to leave a little earlier and park on the side street.
Oh, and the entrance has moved round the back for now. There's a sign by the pharmacy door.
If you need to change the appointment, just ring the surgery on the usual number, there's no rush at all.
No, there's nothing to pay, it's all covered. You don't need to give me any details, I'm only confirming the time.
Is there anything else you'd like me to pass on to the doctor before Tuesday?
Right you are. Take care, and we'll see you on Tuesday. Bye now.
